_comment: Guided tour of the Zenodo deposit tool. 'name' is the emtk control (a spec action, or a table).

steps.title: Name the record
steps.text: In 0 · Create, type the record's name: lower case, no spaces. It becomes the folder and the archive name. (Already have one? Pick it in the list at the top instead.)

await.hint: Type a name for the record.

steps.title: Make the record
steps.text: Give it a title, then press Create record; it stays grey until the name is valid. (A record a project script builds is under Advanced.)

await.hint: Create a record, or pick one in the list.

steps.title: Put its data in
steps.text: Choose Measurement or Calibration, name the item, then Add files… or Add folder…. Files are hard-linked, never overwritten.

steps.title: What Zenodo shows
steps.text: Fill in step 3: title, creators as Family, Given, description, keywords. What is missing is listed under the form. Then Scan for review.

steps.title: Pick a record
steps.text: Each row is one future Zenodo entry. Its review lives beside the folder, never inside the upload. Click the record you want to check.

steps.title: Flagged items first
steps.text: Every measurement folder, calibration folder and metadata file is one row. A ⚠ means the builder could not decide alone: data was added, or a role was inferred. Hover a row for the reason, click it for the details.

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: A row's Approve button binds your decision to the item's content: if it changes later, it is pending again. Right-click a row to Reject it (the record is blocked until it is fixed), undo a decision, or open it in ndX.

steps.title: Upload a draft
steps.text: Upload draft stays grey until every item is approved and the package matches what you approved. It uploads into a Zenodo draft and checks the md5 there; nothing is published.

steps.title: Publishing is separate
steps.text: Approve publish approves exactly this package; Publish is grey until the draft matches it. Publishing is irreversible.
